Strawberry Mojito
By: spiceblogger
Published: Friday, April 13, 2012 - 12:36pm

Ingredients




fresh lime wedges
fresh mint leaves
strawberries
2oz white rum
2 tsp sugar
club soda

Preparation

1 Muddle about 10 mint leaves together with 2 lime wedges in a tall tumbler.  Add sugar, sliced strawberries and 2 more lime wedges.  Muddle again. 2 Fill glass with ice.  Add rum and top off with club soda.
